rule: Overrides may downgrade or clarify evidence; they may not upgrade a run without a verified EVIDENCE_STATUS.json.

exact_strip.reason: Legacy 2-D ISAM target was evaluated at the wrong axial coordinate; retained only for provenance.

order_audit/tio2.reason: Large-download workflow preserved diagnostics but did not produce verified metrics.

order_audit/leaf.reason: Large-download workflow preserved diagnostics but did not produce verified metrics.

superfactor_holdout.reason: Legacy workflow preserved provenance only; use committed_subset_audit support results instead.

published_fig4_point.reason: Registered same-point processed-output comparison; method volumes are separately normalized and not raw physical energy.

published_fig5_aline.reason: Deposited leaf-output format/reproduction boundary; not an independent raw-data validation.

exact_leaf.reason: Exploratory selected A-lines, not a paired full-volume population analysis.

exact_crop.reason: Limited 2-D surrogate; not a complete 512x512 3-D ISAM validation.
